name: London
about: Summer has the best weather odds and biggest crowds, winter is grey but has Christmas markets and thinner queues.
overview: Centuries of history, world-class museums (many free), and a theater scene to match, connected by the Tube.
costOverview: There isn't much of a cheap layer here — a pint and the Tube both run higher than most cities' equivalents.

specialSeasons.text: Christmas markets and festive lights fill the city, from Hyde Park's Winter Wonderland to the Southbank.
